acceptedAnswer.text: Grounds for contested divorce include cruelty, adultery, desertion, mental disorder, or renunciation under the Hindu Marriage Act. A thorough evaluation of facts is required to build a case.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if one spouse can prove specific statutory grounds like cruelty or desertion, a contested divorce can be granted by the court even without the other spouse's consent.
